Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. Duplicate, counterfeit, i mitation, second-hand, refurbished or reconditioned products shall not be accepted under any circumstan ces. 5. Any deviation or substitution without prior written approval of the Buyer shall be treated as a breach of contractual conditions. 6. STRICT PROHIBITION ON DUPLICATE MATERIAL The successful bidder shall not supply duplicate, locally assembled, inferior-quality or unauthorised substit ute products against the approved technical specifications. The Buyer reserves the right to verify the genui neness and originality of supplied materials through appropriate inspection and verification procedures. 7. MANUFACTURER'S DOCUMENTS AND AUTHENTICITY The bidder shall submit genuine manufacturer-issued datasheets, product catalogues, warranty document s, serial number details and other relevant technical documents, wherever applicable. The supplier shall replace such material at its own cost within the stipulated period, as per th e contract conditions. 9. ents. The successful bidder shall ensure that all supplied electrical items fully comply with the specification s and quality requirements stipulated by the Buyer. No unauthorised substitution, deviation or compromis e in quality shall be permitted. .
